title.zh-TW: 擴充套件市集安裝與來源檢核
title.en: Plugin Marketplace Installation and Source Verification

body.zh-TW: 當你想安裝團隊推薦或第三方維護的外掛套件時，指令操作變得更加俐落安全。`claude plugin install` 現在支援 `--marketplace <source>` 參數，`<source>` 是要安裝外掛的市集來源。若本地尚未加入該市集，會先執行相同的安全政策檢查並自動添加，再直接完成安裝。在初次啟動時，各項套件指令一定會等組織管理的原則完全載入才放行。若設定檔宣告的市集名稱看似官方來源，介面也會給予清楚的識別引導。⟦彷彿到圖書館借閱特定館藏，館員會先依規定審驗借書證並登記新書庫，隨即直接將書本遞到你手中，不必分兩趟跑櫃檯。⟧
body.en: When you want to install plugins recommended by your team or maintained by third parties, command-line operations become cleaner and safer. `claude plugin install` now supports the `--marketplace <source>` flag, where `<source>` is the marketplace source to install the plugin from. If the marketplace has not been added locally, it performs the same security policy checks, automatically adds it, and completes the installation directly. On initial startup, plugin commands wait until organization-managed policies are fully loaded before proceeding. If a configured marketplace name resembles an official source, the interface also provides clear identification guidance. ⟦Like borrowing a specific collection from a library, the librarian verifies your library card according to regulations, registers the new catalog, and hands you the book directly without requiring two separate trips to the counter.⟧

items.original:
Added `--marketplace <source>` to `claude plugin install`: adds the marketplace if needed, under the same policy checks as `claude plugin marketplace add`, then installs the plugin from it
Fixed `claude plugin` commands such as `marketplace add` and `install` running before an organization's managed settings had loaded on a first run
Improved the steps shown when a marketplace declared in a settings file has a name that looks like an official Anthropic marketplace

title.zh-TW: 子代理思考深度與執行限制
title.en: Subagent Thinking Depth and Execution Limits

body.zh-TW: 當你指派背景任務給子代理處理繁重工作時，能更精準調度它的心力與權限。Agent 工具新增 `effort` 參數，讓你指定子代理投入的思考深度。代理名稱最多 256 字元，超過會被拒絕；技能或外掛檔案的 `name` 超過此長度則會被忽略。自動模式若被設定停用、觸發 circuit breaker（斷路保護，達到保護條件時停用）或模型不支援，設有 `permissionMode: auto` 的子代理不會再進入自動模式。若主對話已因用量額度（允許使用的上限）耗盡而停止，背景代理碰到同一限制時，不再逐個重複跳出警示。⟦好比主管分派助手調研，可以交代各自要鑽研多深；預算耗盡後，也不再讓每位助手接連敲門重複警告。⟧
body.en: When you assign background tasks to subagents for heavy workloads, you can allocate their effort and permissions more precisely. The Agent tool adds an `effort` parameter, allowing you to specify the thinking depth invested by a subagent. Agent names are capped at 256 characters and rejected if they exceed this limit, while skill or plugin file `name` properties exceeding this length are ignored. If auto mode is disabled by configuration, triggers a circuit breaker (a safety mechanism that disables execution when protection thresholds are reached), or is unsupported by the model, subagents configured with `permissionMode: auto` will no longer enter auto mode. If the main conversation stops because the usage quota (the allowed usage ceiling) is exhausted, background agents encountering the same limit will not trigger repeated alerts one by one. ⟦Think of a manager assigning assistants to research topics who can specify how deeply each should dig; once the budget is exhausted, assistants no longer knock on the door one after another with repeated warnings.⟧

items.original:
Added an `effort` parameter to the Agent tool, so Claude runs a sub-agent at the effort level you ask for
Fixed subagent definitions with `permissionMode: auto` entering auto mode when auto mode is unavailable (disabled by settings, circuit breaker, or a model that doesn't support it)
Fixed the usage limit alert repeating once per background agent when agents failed on a limit that had already stopped the main conversation
Changed agent names to allow at most 256 characters: a longer one is rejected, and a skill's or a plugin file's `name` longer than that is ignored

title.zh-TW: 外掛功能事件與測試機制
title.en: Plugin Feature Events and Testing Mechanisms

body.zh-TW: 自訂外掛模組時，你能補上輸入建議，也能看清工具為何被擋。`prompt.autocomplete` 事件讓模組加入輸入框的補齊選項。`$.model.complete` 的 `prompt`、`system` 接受文字區塊；在區塊上設 `cache: true`，會快取（暫存以便重用）截至該區塊的請求。`agent.spawn` 掛鉤（事件觸發的小程式）加入工作流程代理及其 run 執行、index 索引資訊，供模組拒絕啟動。Write、Edit、NotebookEdit、LSP 列及單筆 Read、Grep、Glob 列，現在會顯示模組拒絕呼叫的原因。執行 `claude plugin test` 時，測試註冊的掛鉤內 `expect` 檢查失敗，或引擎拒絕樁回應（測試用的替代回答），都會讓測試失敗，不再靜默過關。
body.en: When customizing plugin modules, you can provide input suggestions and see clearly why tools were blocked. The `prompt.autocomplete` event allows modules to contribute completion options to the input box. The `prompt` and `system` fields of `$.model.complete` accept text blocks; setting `cache: true` on a block caches (temporarily stores for reuse) requests up to that block. The `agent.spawn` hook (a small program triggered by events) adds workflow agents along with their run execution and index information, allowing modules to reject startup. Write, Edit, NotebookEdit, LSP rows, and single Read, Grep, and Glob rows now display why a module rejected the call. When running `claude plugin test`, failed `expect` checks inside test-registered hooks or an engine rejection of stub responses (substitute answers used for testing) will fail the test instead of passing silently.

items.original:
Added `prompt.autocomplete`, an event a mod hooks to add its own rows to the prompt box's autocomplete list
Added prompt caching to `$.model.complete` for mods: `prompt` and `system` take blocks of text, and `cache: true` on a block caches the request up to it
Added workflow agents to the `agent.spawn` mod hook, with their run and index, so a mod can refuse them
Fixed Write, Edit, NotebookEdit and LSP rows, and single Read, Grep and Glob rows, hiding why a mod denied the call: the row now shows the reason
Changed `claude plugin test`: a failed `expect` inside a hook the test registered, or a stub answer the engine refuses, now fails the test instead of passing silently

title.zh-TW: 外掛攔截掛鉤與權限邏輯修復
title.en: Plugin Interception Hooks and Permission Logic Fixes

body.zh-TW: 外掛攔截操作時，失敗原因與確認視窗不該消失。掛鉤（事件觸發的小程式）`config.set`、`state.set`、`env.set`、`agent.spawn` 呼叫 `next(e)` 後拒絕，改為具名回報掛鉤失敗；呼叫後在回合中斷時失敗，則拒絕呼叫。`/theme`、`/config` Theme 選單及首次主題設定，都先詢問 `config.set` 才儲存。`tool.check` 放行也不再跳過問題或計畫核准視窗。丟棄提示詞或拒絕設定的理由超過 4096 字元，不再被忽略。`tool.call` 看到的是修正錯名參數後的引數。另一模組的掛鉤在守衛自身 `$` 呼叫下發起呼叫時，守衛的 `.catch` 現在會被詢問。掛鉤輸出的 `<system-reminder>` 標籤會先轉義，讓 Claude 收到的是文字。
body.en: When plugins intercept operations, failure reasons and confirmation prompts should not vanish. When the hooks (small programs triggered by events) `config.set`, `state.set`, `env.set`, and `agent.spawn` reject after calling `next(e)`, they now report the named hook failure; if they fail upon turn interruption after the call, the call is rejected. The `/theme` command, `/config` Theme menu, and initial theme setup now query `config.set` before saving. Approvals from `tool.check` no longer bypass question or plan approval prompts. Rejection reasons exceeding 4096 characters for dropped prompts or rejected settings are no longer ignored. `tool.call` now sees arguments with corrected parameter names. When another module's hook initiates a call under a guarded `$` invocation, the guard's `.catch` handler is now consulted. The `<system-reminder>` tag output by hooks is now escaped so Claude receives it as plain text.

items.original:
Fixed a mod's `config.set`, `state.set`, `env.set` or `agent.spawn` hook that denies after calling `next(e)` being answered as a refusal: the hook is now reported as failed, by name
Fixed `/theme`, the `/config` Theme menu and the first-run theme step saving a theme before a plugin's `config.set` hook was asked
Fixed a plugin's `tool.check` hook answering allow running a tool that requires your answer (a question, a plan approval) without showing its dialog
Fixed a mod's hook that called `next(e)` and then failed while the turn was interrupted letting the call through; the call is now rejected
Fixed a plugin's prompt drop or setting deny being ignored when its reason was longer than 4,096 characters
Fixed plugin `tool.call` hooks seeing some tool calls before misnamed parameters were repaired; a hook now sees the arguments the tool will run with
Fixed a mod's guard hook with a `.catch` being skipped silently for calls another mod's hook makes beneath the guard's own `$` call; its `.catch` is now asked
Improved hook output handling: `<system-reminder>` tags written in a hook's output are escaped before they reach Claude

title.zh-TW: 外掛模組載入效能與工作行程修復
title.en: Plugin Module Loading Performance and Worker Process Fixes

body.zh-TW: 在載入複雜外掛或背景工作單元重新啟動時，你可能遇到等待數分鐘或啟動工作重複出現。掛鉤模組透過同一個 const 常數大量呼叫 `$.state`，不再拖慢載入與驗證。`claude plugin validate` 不再列出引擎從別處讀取的 matcher 匹配條件或狀態值；透過頂層 `var` 讀取狀態，若該變數重複宣告或被重新賦值，模組現在會被拒絕。外掛提供的 `$` 方法不再重啟掛鉤來源，讓守衛掛鉤的 `.catch` 無限重跑。掛鉤（事件觸發的小程式）工作單元替換時，啟動提示詞、指令或子代理不再重複排隊。組織外掛重載或另一外掛崩潰後，若回傳個人模組已加入的 `$` 名稱，改卸載個人模組。重啟期間，外掛介面呼叫仍經過其他外掛加上的掛鉤，工具呼叫也仍經過權限掛鉤。
body.en: When loading complex plugins or restarting background worker units, you might have experienced multi-minute delays or duplicated startup jobs. Hook modules making frequent `$.state` calls through the same const binding no longer slow down loading and validation. `claude plugin validate` no longer outputs matchers or state values read elsewhere by the engine; reading state through top-level `var` declarations is now rejected if the variable is re-declared or reassigned. Plugin-provided `$` methods no longer restart the hook source, which previously caused guarded hook `.catch` handlers to rerun infinitely. When replacing hook (a small program triggered by events) worker units, startup prompts, commands, or subagents are no longer queued redundantly. After an organization plugin reloads or another plugin crashes, returning a `$` method name already added by a personal module now unloads the personal module instead. During restarts, plugin interface calls still pass through hooks added by other plugins, and tool calls still pass through permission hooks.

items.original:
Fixed plugins whose hooks module makes many `$.state` calls through one const taking minutes to load or validate
Fixed `claude plugin validate` listing a matcher or state value for a hooks module that the engine reads from elsewhere
Fixed `claude plugin validate` listing a `$.state` value read through a top-level `var` that was declared again or reassigned; such a module is now refused
Fixed a plugin's served `$` method restarting the hook origin, which could run a guard hook with a `.catch` above it again without end
Fixed plugin interface calls made while the plugin hooks worker restarts running without the hooks other plugins put on them
Fixed a mod's start-up prompt, command or subagent being queued a second time when the hooks worker was replaced
Fixed an organization's plugin being unloaded on its own reload, or after another plugin crashed, when it returned a `$` name that a user-installed mod had added; the mod is now unloaded instead
Fixed tool calls made while the plugin hooks worker restarts being answered without the plugins' permission hooks

title.zh-TW: 沙盒隔離機制與敏感路徑防護
title.en: Sandbox Isolation Mechanisms and Sensitive Path Protection

body.zh-TW: 你在沙盒（限制存取的環境）跑指令時，不能再讀取`~/.claude/seed-admin`的`/ultrareview`上傳副本。受管理及並列使用者禁讀路徑在工作階段中途出現或改指向，會撤銷內部專案授權、停止涵蓋檔案的憑證（登入證明）注入。macOS、Windows 讀筆記本或 PDF，不再因中途換連結取得未核准檔案。設定抓取失敗時，竄改快取（暫存）不能停用或取代內建原則外掛。Windows 家目錄或磁碟的 8.3 短檔名等拼法也算`rm -rf`刪除對象。PreToolUse 掛鉤核准與自動模式不再略過 UNC 網路檔案讀取的權限提示。在使用者設定、受管理設定或`--settings`指定的設定中啟用嚴格沙盒模式後，帶環境變數（執行時傳給程式的設定值）前綴的直譯器指令，例如`FOO=bar python3 app.py`，不再跳出詢問。
body.en: When running commands in a sandbox (an environment with restricted access), you can no longer read the `/ultrareview` upload copy in `~/.claude/seed-admin`. If managed or co-located user read-restricted paths appear or are repointed mid-session, internal project authorizations are revoked, and credential (proof of authentication) injection for covered files is stopped. Reading notebooks or PDFs on macOS and Windows no longer accesses unapproved files due to mid-operation symlink swapping. When fetching configuration fails, tampered cache (temporary storage) cannot disable or replace built-in policy plugins. The 8.3 short names and other alternate Windows spellings of home directories or drives are now recognized as deletion targets for `rm -rf`. PreToolUse hook approvals and auto mode no longer bypass permission prompts for reading UNC network files. After enabling strict sandbox mode in user settings, managed settings, or settings specified via `--settings`, interpreter commands prefixed with environment variables (runtime configuration values passed to programs), such as `FOO=bar python3 app.py`, no longer trigger confirmation prompts.

items.original:
Fixed sandboxed commands being able to read the staged file copies of `/ultrareview` uploads under `~/.claude/seed-admin`
Fixed a managed sandbox read-deny path (and user ones beside it) that appears or re-points mid-session not dropping project grants inside it or ending credential injection from files it covers
Fixed a notebook or PDF read on macOS and Windows being able to return a file outside what was approved, through a link swapped in mid-read
Fixed a tampered on-disk cache of server-managed settings being able to switch off or unseat the built-in policy plugin while the settings fetch failed
Fixed `rm -rf` on the 8.3 short name or another alternate Windows spelling of the home folder or a drive not being treated as removing it
Security: Fixed PreToolUse hook approvals and auto mode bypassing the permission prompt for file reads from network (UNC) paths
Improved sandbox auto-allow: with strict sandbox mode set in user, managed or --settings settings, an interpreter command with an env var prefix like `FOO=bar python3 app.py` runs unprompted

title.zh-TW: 工作階段恢復與背景排程修復
title.en: Session Resumption and Background Scheduling Fixes

body.zh-TW: 當你重新打開先前的對話繼續工作，或放著循環指令在背景執行時，恢復後的模式與排程不該悄悄失效。從 `claude --resume` 選單或 `/resume` 回到工作階段，計畫模式會正確還原。`/resume`、`/branch` 或 `/clear` 後建立並儲存的排程不再永遠不觸發；任務檔案在相隔幾毫秒內寫入兩次後，也不再忽略後續新增與刪除。單次 `claude -p` 與 Agent SDK（讓程式呼叫代理的工具組）不再於最終結果後 5 秒停止背景指令，而會等待它們；只有單次 `claude -p` 另修好遺漏排程喚醒的問題，會等待喚醒。背景工作階段的行程重啟後，`/loop` 不再因喚醒遺失而默默停止。⟦智慧書籤以前會漏掉重開後的提醒，現在能保住閱讀模式，也不再把待響的計時器忘在上一頁。⟧
body.en: When you reopen a previous conversation to resume work or leave loop commands running in the background, restored modes and schedules should not silently break. Returning to a session from the `claude --resume` menu or `/resume` correctly restores plan mode. Schedules created and saved after `/resume`, `/branch`, or `/clear` no longer fail to trigger permanently; task files written twice within milliseconds no longer ignore subsequent additions and deletions. One-shot `claude -p` and the Agent SDK (a toolkit allowing programs to invoke agents) no longer terminate background commands 5 seconds after the final result, waiting for them instead; only one-shot `claude -p` additionally fixes missed scheduled wakeups and waits for wakeups. After a background session process restarts, `/loop` no longer silently halts due to lost wakeups. ⟦Picture a smart bookmark that previously forgot reminders upon reopening; it now preserves your reading mode and no longer leaves pending timers behind on the previous page.⟧

items.original:
Fixed one-shot `claude -p` and Agent SDK runs stopping a background command 5 seconds after the final result, and one-shot `claude -p` runs dropping a scheduled wakeup; both are now waited for
Fixed plan mode not being restored when resuming a session from the `claude --resume` session picker or with `/resume`
Fixed saved scheduled tasks created after `/resume`, `/branch` or `/clear` never firing, and saved tasks ignoring later creates and deletes after two writes to the tasks file milliseconds apart
Fixed a background session's `/loop` silently stopping when the session's process restarted (for example after a crash), because its pending wakeup was lost

title.zh-TW: 檔案讀取、搜尋重試與大型附件處理
title.en: File Reading, Search Retries, and Large Attachment Handling

body.zh-TW: 當你請 Claude 搜尋程式碼、翻閱文件或在提示詞中引用檔案時，各項讀取工具的回應更加明確。Grep 與 Glob 遇到無法讀取的檔案或資料夾，不再誤報查無結果；Claude 會重試一次或告訴你。`@` 引用超過 256KB 的文字檔不再被默默略過，Claude 會收到檔案大小及分段讀取指示。Read 讀取 PDF 時，若 `pages` 是 `"6,9,15"` 這類離散頁碼清單，不再只回傳第一頁，而會報錯要求逐頁或逐範圍讀取。設有 Read 拒絕規則且工作目錄位於符號連結（指向別處的捷徑檔）下時，不存在檔案的 `@` 字詞不再誤顯示 `"could not be examined"`。Grep 接受以 `file_path` 代替 `path`；Write、WebFetch、Read 則忽略少數多餘參數，不再因此讓呼叫失敗。
body.en: When you ask Claude to search code, browse documents, or reference files in prompts, responses from various reading tools are much clearer. When Grep and Glob encounter unreadable files or directories, they no longer falsely report no results; Claude retries once or notifies you. Mentioning text files exceeding 256KB with `@` is no longer silently ignored, as Claude receives the file size alongside instructions to read in chunks. When Read parses PDFs, specifying discrete page lists such as `"6,9,15"` for `pages` no longer returns only the first page, but errors and requests reading page-by-page or by range. When Read deny rules are configured and the working directory is under a symlink (a shortcut pointing to another location), `@` references to nonexistent files no longer erroneously display `"could not be examined"`. Grep accepts `file_path` in place of `path`; Write, WebFetch, and Read ignore a few extra parameters rather than failing the call.

items.original:
Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the file or folder they were given could not be read; Claude now retries once or tells you
Fixed the Read tool returning only the first entry, with no error, when a PDF's `pages` was a list such as "6,9,15"; it now returns an error saying to read each page or range separately
Fixed @-mentioned text files over 256KB being left out silently: Claude is now told the file's size and to read it in portions
Fixed a spurious "could not be examined" note for @-words that name no file when a Read deny rule is set and the working directory is under a symlink
Improved tool input handling: Grep accepts `file_path` for `path`, and Write, WebFetch and Read ignore a few stray parameters instead of failing the call

title.zh-TW: 提示詞指令與操作權限管理
title.en: Prompt Commands and Operation Permission Management

body.zh-TW: 當你在對話中切換操作模式、目錄或管理既有產出時，舊紀錄不該讓工具限制突然回來。中途離開自動模式或計畫模式後，技能或斜線指令的 `allowed-tools` 規則不會再於後續回合復發。`/cd` 或權限變更後，`"instruction file not loaded"` 這類指引檔案未載入紀錄不再過時或缺漏；巢狀指引檔案未載入也會留下對話紀錄。對話壓縮摘要重複 `/name`，不再讓 Claude 呼叫保留給使用者的技能。Artifact 產物工具現在讓 Claude 看見已發布產物總數，一次可列出 200 項，上限原為 50 項。⟦調度中心翻閱舊紀錄時，以前可能誤開人工專用按鈕；現在舊摘要不再放行這些操作，清冊也能列出更多項目。⟧
body.en: When switching operation modes, changing directories, or managing existing outputs during a conversation, stale records should not suddenly revive tool restrictions. After leaving auto mode or plan mode mid-session, `allowed-tools` rules from skills or slash commands no longer resurface in subsequent turns. Following `/cd` or permission changes, records for unloaded instruction files like `"instruction file not loaded"` are no longer outdated or missing; unread nested instruction files also leave conversation logs. Repeating `/name` in conversation compaction summaries no longer allows Claude to invoke user-reserved skills. The Artifact tool now allows Claude to see the total number of published artifacts and list up to 200 items at once, raised from 50 items. ⟦A dispatch center reviewing old logs might previously have pressed manual-only buttons by mistake; now old summaries no longer permit those actions, and registries can display more items.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a skill's or slash command's `allowed-tools` rule coming back in a later turn when you leave auto mode or plan mode partway through that turn
Fixed "instruction file not loaded" lines going stale or missing after `/cd` or a permission change, and added a transcript line when a nested one isn't loaded
Fixed a compaction summary that repeated `/name` letting Claude invoke a skill that is reserved for the user
Improved the Artifact tool's listing: Claude now sees how many published artifacts you have and can list up to 200 at once instead of 50

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入、貼上與 Vim 操作修復
title.en: Terminal Input, Paste, and Vim Operation Fixes

body.zh-TW: 在終端機快速輸入、使用中文輸入法或透過 Vim 模式編輯提示詞時，你可能遇到文字被漏掉或按鍵被誤認。多次貼上在同一提示詞中重疊進行，不再把部分貼上內容當成逐字鍵入。底欄列被選取時，快速輸入、輸入法文字及分解形式的重音字元不再遺失；`!` 也不再留住選取狀態。Vim（用按鍵指令編輯文字的模式）游標不再超出行尾，j/k 經過短行仍保留原欄位；`f`／`t`／`F`／`T`／`;`／`,` 不再跳至其他行的匹配位置，或刪除到那裡。`/add-dir` 路徑框不再讓 Shift+Enter 或貼上新增換行，也不再把快速打出的 `"tab"`、`"up"`、`"down"` 誤當按鍵。⟦鍵盤接待員以前會把字串認成按鍵、把貼上認成打字，現在能分清這些輸入。⟧
body.en: When typing quickly in the terminal, using Chinese input methods, or editing prompts in Vim mode, you might have experienced dropped characters or misinterpreted keystrokes. Overlapping multiple paste actions in the same prompt no longer treats portions of pasted content as literal keystrokes. When the bottom bar is selected, fast input, IME text, and decomposed accented characters are no longer lost; `!` also no longer preserves the selection state. The Vim (a mode for editing text using key commands) cursor no longer moves past the end of the line, and j/k motions retain their column across shorter lines; `f`, `t`, `F`, `T`, `;`, and `,` no longer jump to matches on other lines or delete up to them. The `/add-dir` path box no longer allows Shift+Enter or pasted content to insert newlines, nor does it misinterpret quickly typed `"tab"`, `"up"`, or `"down"` as key events. ⟦A keyboard receptionist who previously confused text strings for keystrokes and paste events for typing now distinguishes these inputs accurately.⟧

items.original:
Fixed some pasted text reaching Claude as typed text when several pastes overlapped in one prompt
Fixed vim mode leaving the cursor past the end of a line, j/k losing their column on shorter lines, and `f`/`t`/`F`/`T`/`;`/`,` jumping to, or deleting up to, a match on another line of the prompt
Fixed `/add-dir` path box letting Shift+Enter or a paste add a line break, and treating fast-typed "tab", "up" or "down" as those keys
Fixed fast typing, input-method text and decomposed accents being dropped while a prompt footer row was selected, and `!` leaving the row selected

title.zh-TW: 終端機畫面呈現與互動操作改善
title.en: Terminal Display Rendering and Interactive Operation Improvements

body.zh-TW: 當你瀏覽長篇回覆或找回草稿時，畫面與選單不該讓你重做操作。`/bug`、`/share`、`/feedback <text>` 送出途中按 Ctrl+O 或 Ctrl+Z，不再重新開始；送出後也不再以取消狀態關閉。`/remote-env` 開啟時選中已儲存的預設環境，直接按 Enter 不再改掉它；沒有生效中的預設值時，各列都不打勾。偵測到 iTerm2 時，全螢幕模式不再於每次縮放或 Ctrl+L 都送出全螢幕清除，這可能是舊畫面塞滿捲動紀錄的原因。長篇項目符號或編號回覆在串流、縮放及 Ctrl+O 重開紀錄時，顯示更快。Ctrl+C 清掉的草稿，執行斜線指令或送出訊息後仍能按 Up 找回。`/focus` 提示會邀你在回合中試用聚焦檢視，並告訴你怎麼切回。
body.en: When browsing long responses or retrieving drafts, screens and menus should not force you to redo actions. Pressing Ctrl+O or Ctrl+Z while submitting `/bug`, `/share`, or `/feedback <text>` no longer restarts them, nor do they close in a cancelled state after submission. Opening `/remote-env` selects the saved default environment, and pressing Enter directly no longer changes it; when no default is active, no rows are checked. When iTerm2 is detected, fullscreen mode no longer sends a fullscreen clear on every resize or Ctrl+L, which may have caused old screens to fill the scrollback history. Long bulleted or numbered responses render faster during streaming, resizing, and reopening history with Ctrl+O. Drafts cleared with Ctrl+C can still be retrieved by pressing Up after running a slash command or sending a message. The `/focus` prompt invites you to try focus view during a turn and explains how to switch back.

items.original:
Fixed `/bug`, `/share` and `/feedback <text>` starting over after Ctrl+O or Ctrl+Z while a report was being sent, and closing as cancelled after it had been sent
Fixed `/remote-env` replacing your saved default environment when you pressed Enter right away: the list now opens on your default, and no row has a check mark when no default is in effect
Fixed fullscreen mode sending a full-screen clear on every window resize and Ctrl+L when iTerm2 is detected, which may be what filled iTerm2's scrollback with stale pages
Improved rendering speed of long bulleted or numbered replies: they stream, resize and re-open in the transcript (ctrl+o) much faster
Improved Ctrl+C draft recovery: a cleared prompt now stays reachable with Up after a slash command or a sent message
Improved the /focus tip: it now invites you to try focus view mid-turn and shows how to switch back

title.zh-TW: MCP 啟動等待與協定版本
title.en: MCP Startup Wait Times and Protocol Versions

body.zh-TW: 串接 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）時，啟動不該卡在等待伺服器。`claude -p` 與 SDK 工作階段首回合，不再等 HTTP／SSE 伺服器回應 `resources/list`。忽略新協定檢查的本機 stdio 伺服器，慢連一次後會被記住 7 天，之後改用舊方式連線、不用再等。本機 stdio MCP 連線在所有安裝環境，包括 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry，預設協商協定版本 `2026-07-28`，設 `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` 可退出。名稱超過 128 字元的 MCP 工具會被排除，並由錯誤訊息點名，不再讓每個請求都失敗。
body.en: When connecting through MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools), startup should not get stuck waiting for servers. The first turn of `claude -p` and SDK sessions no longer waits for HTTP/SSE servers to respond to `resources/list`. Local stdio servers that ignore new protocol checks are remembered for 7 days after one slow connection, subsequently connecting via the legacy method without further waiting. Local stdio MCP connections across all installation environments, including Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, negotiate protocol version `2026-07-28` by default, with `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` available to opt out. MCP tools with names exceeding 128 characters are excluded and named in error messages, rather than failing every request.

items.original:
Fixed an MCP tool with a name longer than 128 characters making every request fail; that tool is now left out and an MCP error names it
Improved startup of `claude -p` and SDK sessions: the first turn no longer waits for HTTP and SSE MCP servers to answer `resources/list`
Improved startup with local (stdio) MCP servers that ignore the newer protocol check: after one slow connect they are remembered for 7 days and connected the older way without the wait
Changed local (stdio) MCP server connections to negotiate protocol version 2026-07-28 by default on every install, including Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry; `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` opts out

title.zh-TW: 代理設定、過載重試與可點連結
title.en: Proxy Configuration, Overload Retries, and Clickable Links

body.zh-TW: 公司網路走代理伺服器時，有些位址本來就該直連。`HTTPS_PROXY` 用來指定代理伺服器。設了它時，Claude Code 自身的 API 請求，包括登入、政策、意見回饋與產物，現在會遵守 `NO_PROXY`（不走代理的清單），以前會忽略它。新增環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS`，可延長遇到 529 過載時退避重試的基礎等待時間；退避重試就是失敗後拉長間隔再試。用量限制訊息裡的 claude.ai 設定連結改成帶 `https://` 的寫法，終端機與應用程式能把它顯示成可點連結。
body.en: When corporate networks route through a proxy server, certain addresses should connect directly. `HTTPS_PROXY` specifies the proxy server. When configured, Claude Code's own API requests—including login, policy, feedback, and artifacts—now respect `NO_PROXY` (the proxy bypass list), which was previously ignored. A new environment variable, `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS`, extends the base wait time for backoff retries when encountering 529 overloads, where retries wait for longer intervals after failures. Links to claude.ai settings within usage limit messages now include `https://`, allowing terminals and applications to render them as clickable links.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer base delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request
Fixed `NO_PROXY` being ignored for Claude Code's own API requests (sign-in, policy, feedback, artifacts) when `HTTPS_PROXY` is set
Changed usage limit messages to write claude.ai settings links with https:// so terminals and apps can make them clickable

title.zh-TW: 桌面應用程式與遠端操控協同
title.en: Desktop App and Remote Control Collaboration

body.zh-TW: 當你透過網頁遠端查看桌面版或 IDE（整合程式編輯與開發工具的環境）託管的工作階段時，背景子代理面板不再空白。從 claude.ai/code 啟動新 Remote Control 遠端操控工作階段，第一則訊息現在和後續訊息一樣接受 PDF 及其他檔案，不再只能附圖片。跨工作階段的送達通知不再把名稱相似的兩個工作階段合成一個接收端；終端機工作階段讓訊息逾期時，逾期通知也不再錯怪桌面版。桌面版已有另一則訊息排隊時，按 `Send now` 不再結束當前回合正在等待的子代理。⟦中控室以前會把兩個相似櫃檯當成同一處，逾期還怪錯窗口；現在通知分清接收端，插送訊息也不再切斷正在等候的通話。⟧
body.en: When viewing sessions hosted on the desktop app or IDE (an environment combining code editing and development tools) remotely via web, the background subagent panel is no longer blank. Starting a new Remote Control session from claude.ai/code now accepts PDFs and other files in the first message just like subsequent messages, rather than only supporting images. Cross-session delivery notifications no longer merge two sessions with similar names into a single recipient, and overdue notifications no longer blame the desktop app when a terminal session allows messages to expire. When another message is already queued in the desktop app, clicking `Send now` no longer terminates the subagent that the current turn is waiting for. ⟦Imagine a central control room that previously merged two similar counters into one location and blamed the wrong desk for overdue items; notifications now separate recipients cleanly, and expediting a message no longer cuts off awaiting calls.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control viewers seeing an empty subagent pane for background subagents in sessions hosted by the desktop app or an IDE
Fixed cross-session delivery notices showing two sessions with similar names as one recipient, and the expiry notice blaming the desktop app when a terminal session let the message lapse
Fixed Send now in the desktop app ending the subagent a turn was waiting on when another message was already queued
[Remote Control] Fixed the first message of a new Remote Control session started from claude.ai/code accepting only images; it now accepts PDFs and other files like later messages

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段狀態與背景任務恢復
title.en: Cloud Session State and Background Task Resumption

body.zh-TW: 把複雜任務交給雲端環境長時間運算時，重啟後哪些背景代理能接著做，需要說清楚。工作單元恰在回合結束時停止，不再讓畫面顯示永遠未結束的回合；長對話也不再偶爾重問已核准的權限。Claude 正在讀取排程任務或其他佇列通知時，重試或編輯訊息不再使它們遺失。容器（承載工作階段的執行環境）重啟後，不再忘記你在用戶端選的思考設定；Claude 也會被告知哪些停止的背景代理可依 id 識別碼恢復。Anthropic 無法確認組織設定時，Cowork 雲端工作階段不再誤報代理伺服器阻擋產物。claude.ai 雲端工作階段無法連上 Claude in Chrome 瀏覽器擴充功能時，Claude 會收到說明：若使用者願意，可以繼續採用替代方式。
body.en: When delegating complex tasks to cloud environments for long-running computation, clarity is needed on which background agents can resume after a restart. Work units stopping exactly at turn completion no longer leave the interface displaying an endless turn, and long conversations no longer occasionally re-prompt for approved permissions. When Claude is reading scheduled tasks or other queued notifications, retrying or editing messages no longer loses them. After containers (the execution environments hosting sessions) restart, they no longer forget the thinking settings selected in your client, and Claude is informed of which stopped background agents can resume by ID. Cowork cloud sessions no longer falsely report that proxy servers blocked artifacts when Anthropic cannot confirm organization settings. When claude.ai cloud sessions cannot connect to the Claude in Chrome browser extension, Claude receives instructions indicating that it may proceed with alternative methods if the user chooses.

items.original:
Fixed a cloud session showing a turn that never ended when its worker was stopped just as the turn finished
Fixed cloud sessions with a large transcript sometimes asking for a permission again after it was approved
Fixed scheduled tasks and other queued notifications being lost in cloud sessions when a message was retried or edited while Claude was reading them
Fixed cloud sessions forgetting the thinking setting chosen in the client when the session's container restarted
Fixed Cowork cloud sessions saying a proxy blocked artifacts when Anthropic couldn't confirm the organization's settings
Improved cloud sessions after a restart: Claude is now told which stopped background agents it can resume by id
Improved the Claude in Chrome message in claude.ai cloud sessions when the browser can't be reached: Claude is now told it may continue with alternatives if the user prefers

title.zh-TW: 雲端例行工作與附件格式支援
title.en: Cloud Routines and Attachment Format Support

body.zh-TW: 讓例行工作自動產生私人檔案時，你不必每次都核准發布。排程執行或按 `Run now` 立即執行，產出僅你可見的新產物都不再詢問核准；產物要求連接器（連接外部服務的工具）或其他存取權時仍會詢問。已完成的工作不再偶爾持續顯示執行中數小時。例行工作沒有已儲存的通知設定時，編輯或複製不再關掉推播通知。SVG、HEIC、TIFF 等較少見的圖片格式不再附加失敗，而會作為一般檔案附加。組織要求核准的連接器工具，不再提供原本無效的 `"Always allow"` 選項。⟦辦公室排程小幫手以前連私人草稿都要找你簽名，現在可以直接發布；要借用外部服務或其他權限，仍得先問你。⟧
body.en: When routines automatically generate private files, you no longer need to approve every publication. Scheduled runs or clicking `Run now` to execute immediately no longer ask for approval when generating new artifacts visible only to you; requests involving connectors (tools that link external services) or other access permissions still prompt for approval. Completed jobs no longer occasionally remain shown as running for hours. Editing or duplicating routines without saved notification settings no longer turns off push notifications. Less common image formats such as SVG, HEIC, and TIFF no longer fail to attach, instead attaching as regular files. Connector tools requiring organizational approval no longer offer the ineffective `"Always allow"` option. ⟦An office routine assistant previously required your signature even for private drafts but can now publish them directly, while borrowing external services or other permissions still requires asking first.⟧

items.original:
Changed scheduled and Run now routine runs to publish a new artifact only you can see without asking for approval; artifacts that request connectors or other access still ask
[Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs occasionally staying listed as running for hours after they had finished
[Cloud sessions] Fixed editing or duplicating a routine turning off its push notifications when the routine had no saved notification setting
[Cloud sessions] Fixed SVG, HEIC, TIFF and other less common image files failing to attach; they now attach as regular files
[Cloud sessions] Fixed approval prompts offering "Always allow" for connector tools that an organization set to require approval; the choice had no effect

title.zh-TW: Claude Tag 團隊通訊與花費控制
title.en: Claude Tag Team Communication and Spend Controls

body.zh-TW: 團隊在 Slack 標記 `@Claude` 時，後續回覆不該等首個請求結束，或因相隔數秒而漏掉。Enterprise 管理員可在頻道 Configure 頁的 Allowed domains 卡片按 Edit，開啟設定網域的存取組合。僅由 GitHub PR（提議合併分支改動的請求）活動或例行工作喚醒的討論串，改用管理員更新的頻道或工作區預設模型。組織額度耗盡不再誤報花費上限；Slack 無法回答的權限提示被自動拒絕後，工作階段不再卡住。`@Claude !status` 說明何時停止讀取未標記訊息、原因，以及再次標記會恢復讀取。`!fork` 延續討論串的首則卡片顯示來源、請求內容、提問者及原串連結。管理設定中花費上限頁的組織整體與預設欄位，按 Save 或 Enter 才儲存，點開別處不會儲存。
body.en: When teams mention `@Claude` in Slack, follow-up replies should not wait for initial requests to finish or be missed due to multi-second gaps. Enterprise administrators can click Edit on the Allowed domains card on a channel's Configure page to open the access bundle that configures its domains. Threads awakened solely by GitHub PR activity or routines switch to the administrator-updated channel or workspace default model. Depleted organization quotas no longer falsely report spend limits, and sessions no longer freeze after Slack auto-rejects unanswerable permission prompts. `@Claude !status` explains when reading unmentioned messages stopped, why, and that mentioning again resumes reading. The initial card of a thread continued with `!fork` displays the source, request content, author, and link to the original thread. In admin settings under spend limits, organization-wide and default fields save only upon pressing Save or Enter, without saving when clicking away.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added an Edit button to the Allowed domains card on a channel's Configure page, so Enterprise admins can open the access bundle that sets the channel's domains
[Claude Tag] Fixed replies sent in a Slack thread while Claude was still on its first request there being held until that request finished, or missed when sent seconds apart
[Claude Tag] Fixed Slack threads woken only by GitHub pull request activity or a routine staying on their original model after an admin changed the channel or workspace default model
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude sometimes posting a spend limit notice in Slack when the real cause was that your organization had run out of usage credits
[Claude Tag] Fixed a session hanging until interrupted when a permission prompt that can't be answered from Slack was denied automatically
[Claude Tag] Improved `@Claude !status` in a channel to say when Claude has stopped reading its untagged messages, why, and that an @-mention starts it reading again
[Claude Tag] Changed the first message of a Slack thread continued with `!fork` to a card showing where it came from, the request, and who asked, with a link to the original thread
[Claude Tag] Changed the organization-wide and default spend limit boxes on Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings to save only when you press Save or Enter, not when you click away

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查統計圖表與分支規則防護
title.en: Code Review Analytics Charts and Branch Rule Guardrails

body.zh-TW: 評估團隊送審 PR（提議合併分支改動的請求）的工作成效或重構專案規範時，能看清各專案的審查數據，也不用擔心分支變更讓檢查失效。審查圖表新增了當期審查總量、前期增減變化以及各儲存庫的明細分析；儲存庫是存放專案檔案與修改紀錄的地方。當 PR 切換目標分支且舊分支已刪除時，待審任務會自動重新排隊。若提交的改動剛好編輯了專案規則檔 `CLAUDE.md`，審查過程會堅持以目標分支上的既有規則為準。⟦就像品質檢驗站不僅能產出各產線的進度對比報表，在工件變更流水線時能自動重新排隊，檢驗標準也堅持採用母廠已核准的規範手冊。⟧
body.en: When evaluating team PR review performance or refactoring project conventions, review metrics across projects are clear without concern that branch changes will invalidate checks. Review charts add current period review totals, period-over-period changes, and breakdown analytics by repository. A repository stores project files and their change history. When a PR switches target branches and the old branch has been deleted, pending review tasks automatically re-queue. If submitted changes happen to edit the project rule file `CLAUDE.md`, the review process strictly adheres to existing rules on the target branch. ⟦Consider a quality inspection station that not only produces progress comparison reports across production lines and automatically re-queues workpieces when lines change, but also strictly enforces the specification manual already approved by headquarters.⟧

items.original:
[Code Review] Added the period's total with its change from the previous period, and a breakdown by repository, to the PRs reviewed chart in Code Review analytics
[Code Review] Fixed a queued review failing when the pull request moved to a new base branch and the old one was deleted; the commit is now re-queued for review
[Code Review] Fixed reviews ignoring a CLAUDE.md's rules when the pull request edits that file; reviews now use its version from the base branch

title.zh-TW: 工作階段對話不再漏接，權限回覆與結束前的訊息完整保留
title.en: Session conversations no longer drop inputs, fully preserving permission responses and pre-exit messages

body.zh-TW: 當你在遠端伺服器上協同作業，或是在終端機處理完任務準備收工離開時，最怕中途確認的操作沒送出，或是最後幾則對話紀錄憑空消失。在先前版本中，雲端工作階段（在遠端主機上連線執行的操作環境）如果在執行途中跳出權限提示，要求你確認是否允許讀取或執行指令，你按下的允許或拒絕回覆有時會被意外漏掉。在結束並退出工作階段時，最後送出或接收到的幾則訊息，過去也可能在關閉當下沒有被寫入而遺失。現在這些在更新後出現的異常都已修復，權限回應與關閉前的紀錄都會確實送達並完整保存。⟦如同跟遠端秘書通話交辦事項，以前對詢問按確認時偶爾會斷訊漏聽，講完準備掛上電話時最後幾句交代也常沒存進紀錄；現在每項授權確認都會確實傳達，離線前留下的最後吩咐也能完整保存。⟧
body.en: When collaborating on a remote server or wrapping up tasks in the terminal to leave, the worst issue is having mid-session confirmation actions fail to send or watching the last few conversation records vanish into thin air. In previous versions, if a cloud session (an operating environment running over a connection to a remote host) prompted for permissions mid-run to confirm whether reading files or executing commands was allowed, your submitted allow or deny responses were sometimes accidentally dropped. When ending and exiting a session, the last few messages sent or received in the past could also be lost without being written at shutdown. These anomalies that appeared after updates are now resolved, ensuring that permission responses and pre-shutdown records are reliably delivered and completely preserved. ⟦Picture assigning tasks over the phone to a remote assistant: previously, confirming an inquiry would occasionally drop out and get missed, and the final instructions before hanging up were often not saved in the record; now, every authorization confirmation is reliably delivered, and the last instructions left before disconnecting are fully preserved.⟧

Fixed a regression in 2.1.290 where cloud sessions could drop answers to permission prompts
Fixed a regression in 2.1.288 where the last messages of a session could be lost when quitting
